Big Pharma's most dangerous lie and the hard truth about cannabis sit side by side in this Tucker Carlson episode. Carlson argues that the drug industry's deepest deception concerns the pills it sells as safe. Against that, he takes a skeptical look at weed and its modern boosters.

The talk works through his case on both fronts, pills versus plants. Carlson questions the claims made for legal cannabis and the money behind its spread. He also attacks the trust placed in large drug firms after recent scandals. Skeptical viewers get a bitter, wide-ranging brief against two industries at once.

Tucker Carlson looks into the true start of Lyme disease in a solo report. The episode title promises the real origins of the tick-borne ill. The tale of Lyme has long drawn claims of lab work gone wrong.

Carlson walks through where the disease first showed and what labs sat near that ground. He weighs the claim that state germ work played a role in its birth. He asks why the tale is brushed off so fast. Listeners get the full case in one place. The library keeps the episode as a record of the claim as he states it.
